import openpyxl
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime, time

path = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\OneDrive - Microsoft\Documents\projects\fabric-rlm-core\_local\bench\aida\runs\qa-m3\work\QA_100\2025-11-04_11：27-_11：42_CO2.xlsx"
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Read all rows
rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
header = rows[0]
print("Header:", header)

# Data rows
data = rows[1:]
print("Total data rows:", len(data))

# Group columns: 2100 heads (G1), 1800 heads (G2), 1500 heads (G3), 1200 heads (G4)
group_names = ["Group 1 (2100 heads)", "Group 2 (1800 heads)", "Group 3 (1500 heads)", "Group 4 (1200 heads)"]
group_cols = [2, 3, 4, 5]  # 0-indexed

# Determine t=0 as the first timestamp; convert time-of-day to seconds since start
def time_to_sec(t):
    if isinstance(t, time):
        return t.hour*3600 + t.minute*60 + t.second
    return None

# Get baseline t0
times_secs = [time_to_sec(r[1]) for r in data]
valid_idx = [i for i,t in enumerate(times_secs) if t is not None]
t0 = min(times_secs[i] for i in valid_idx)
tmax = max(times_secs[i] for i in valid_idx)
print(f"t0={t0}s, tmax={tmax}s, span={tmax-t0}s = {(tmax-t0)/60} min")

results = []
for gi, gc in enumerate(group_cols):
    xs, ys = [], []
    for r in data:
        tsec = time_to_sec(r[1])
        v = r[gc]
        if tsec is None or v is None: 
            continue
        # convert time to minutes elapsed
        x = (tsec - t0) / 60.0
        xs.append(x); ys.append(float(v))
    xs = np.array(xs); ys = np.array(ys)
    # Linear regression
    n = len(xs)
    if n < 2:
        results.append((group_names[gi], None, None, n))
        continue
    slope, intercept = np.polyfit(xs, ys, 1)
    y_pred = slope*xs + intercept
    ss_res = np.sum((ys - y_pred)**2)
    ss_tot = np.sum((ys - np.mean(ys))**2)
    r2 = 1 - ss_res/ss_tot if ss_tot > 0 else float('nan')
    results.append((group_names[gi], slope, r2, n))
    print(f"{group_names[gi]}: n={n}, slope={slope:.6f} ppm/min, R2={r2:.6f}")

# Build final table
print("\n=== FINAL TABLE ===")
print(f"{'Group':<25} {'Emission Rate (ppm/min)':<28} {'R² Coefficient':<15}")
for name, slope, r2, n in results:
    print(f"{name:<25} {round(slope,2):<28} {round(r2,4):<15}")
